fr_html: Mr. ROOT rappelle que M. Hagerup lui a demandé la veille de formuler ses idées à ce sujet. Il présente au Président un texte qu'il a préparé en collaboration avec Lord Phillimore.
en_html: Mr. ROOT recalled that M. Hagerup had asked him on the previous day to put his ideas on the subject in writing. He presented a draft to the President which he had prepared in collaboration with Lord Phillimore.
